attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "This refactors the core Feature/Module manifest attribute (used to declare every feature in every OrchardCore module) removing/renaming public-facing protected constants and helper members (DefaultName, DefaultCategory, DefaultPriority, GetValues, ListDelims\u2192ListDelimiters, Uncategorized, etc.) and changing the Id setter's exception type from InvalidOperationException to ArgumentException, which can silently break any third-party module/theme that subclasses FeatureAttribute/ModuleAttribute or catches the old exception type, and the FeaturesProvider change from Features.ToList() to the raw mutable list risks introducing shared-state bugs across tenants if that list is later mutated."}
